summary_text: In May 2026, the user placed eight separate orders across weekdays and weekends, primarily in the afternoon. The baskets were diverse, featuring frequent purchases of Aerated Drinks, Milk, and Cookies Biscuits, often combined with other categories like Canned Food, Vegetables, or Ice Creams. No single category combination or daypart behavior repeated across two or more independent dates. All observed patterns are based on isolated transactions, resulting in low confidence for any durable preference or routine inference.
